summary: Jupiter Neurosciences, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts offering of 307,692 shares of common stock at $6.50 per share, raising approximately $2.0 million gross. D. Boral Capital LLC acted as placement agent with a 7.0% cash fee. The offering is a routine capital raise under Form S-3, not a special situation. The filing notes a 1-for-75 reverse stock split effective August 6, 2026. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No deal terms or strategic event are involved; this is an ordinary shelf takedown.
